title: Friction magnitude and direction
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the kinetic friction force as 4 N and identifies its direction as opposing the block's motion (left).

title: Block acceleration
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the block's deceleration magnitude as 2 m/s² and states its direction is left.

title: Board acceleration
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the board's acceleration magnitude as 4 m/s² and states its direction is right.

title: Relative motion analysis
description: Important: Applies kinematics to find the time and common velocity (2 m/s) when relative motion stops.

title: Displacement calculation
description: Important: Correctly calculates the displacements of the block and board relative to the ground using kinematics.

title: Minimum board length
description: Essential: Correctly computes the minimum length L as 0.75 m from the relative displacement.

title: Newton's third law application
description: Important: Recognizes the friction force on the board is equal in magnitude and opposite in direction to that on the block.

title: Sign/direction confusion
description: Pitfall: Confuses the direction of accelerations or assigns friction to the wrong object.

title: Incorrect relative displacement
description: Pitfall: Uses the sum of displacements instead of their difference to find L.
